paper_cards.title: DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos
paper_cards.data: 44,000+ hours of egocentric human video spanning daily environments, objects, and dexterous interactions, followed by small target-robot post-training sets.
paper_cards.method: A video foundation world model pretrained with continuous latent proxy actions on unlabeled human video, robot-action post-training, and few-step autoregressive distillation for real-time rollout.
paper_cards.task: Generate action-conditioned robot futures for teleoperation, policy evaluation, and model-based planning across embodiments.
paper_cards.novelty: Transfers interaction knowledge from unprecedented-scale unlabeled human video into a controllable robot world model and distills it to sustained real-time generation.
paper_cards.evidence: The official project reports 10.81 FPS generation, stable rollouts beyond one minute, and applications to live teleoperation, policy evaluation, and planning.

paper_cards.title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation
paper_cards.data: Short real-world videos converted into digital twins plus object, scene, and task digital cousins across seven manipulation tasks and five policy architectures.
paper_cards.method: A modular extraction-generation-augmentation pipeline segments a video, reconstructs objects and background, estimates physics and articulation, compiles an OmniGibson scene, and generates affordance-preserving cousins.
paper_cards.task: Automatically build editable simulation-ready scenes for robot-policy training and evaluation from real video.
paper_cards.novelty: Connects automated real-to-sim reconstruction with systematic digital-cousin generation and validates both policy ranking and zero-shot real transfer.
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports mean sim-real Pearson correlation 0.911 and zero-shot real success gains of 17%, 21%, and 40% from object, scene, and task cousins.

paper_cards.title: MolmoB0T: Large-Scale Simulation Enables Zero-Shot Manipulation
paper_cards.data: 1.7M expert manipulation trajectories over 11K+ objects, 94K+ procedurally generated environments, eight tasks, and Franka FR3 plus RB-Y1 embodiments.
paper_cards.method: A suite of behavior-cloned policies trained only on aggressively randomized procedural simulation data, with VLM-based, lightweight-transformer, and pi0-compatible architectures.
paper_cards.task: Zero-shot sim-to-real pick-and-place, articulated-object manipulation, and door opening on unseen objects and environments.
paper_cards.novelty: Demonstrates a fully open sim-only manipulation stack that transfers zero-shot to two real robot platforms without target-domain fine-tuning.
paper_cards.evidence: Ai2 reports full models, data, engine, training and evaluation code; the paper reports 79.2% Franka pick-and-place success versus 39.2% for the matched pi0.5-DROID comparison.

paper_cards.title: MolmoSpaces: A Large-Scale Open Ecosystem for Robot Navigation and Manipulation
paper_cards.data: 230K+ indoor scenes, 130K+ curated object assets, and 42M+ physics-grounded 6-DoF grasps, with cross-simulator conversion and controlled splits.
paper_cards.method: An open asset, scene, grasp, validation, conversion, trajectory-generation, and benchmark stack with explicit physical parameters and systematic variation axes.
paper_cards.task: Provide scalable physics-grounded infrastructure for training and diagnosing navigation and manipulation policies.
paper_cards.novelty: Unifies unusually large scene, asset, grasp, simulator-portability, and factor-controlled evaluation layers in one open embodied ecosystem.
paper_cards.evidence: The official release documents 95%+ scene validation pass rates, 42M grasps over 48K+ objects, and compatibility with MuJoCo, ManiSkill, Isaac Lab, and Isaac Sim.

paper_cards.title: Vesta: A Generalist Embodied Reasoning Model
paper_cards.data: A curated SFT mixture spanning localization, navigation, spatial intelligence, grounding, embodied reasoning, general VLM data, and real-robot action planning.
paper_cards.method: Qwen3-VL-8B fine-tuning plus a multimodal memory harness that interleaves observations, textual progress state, reasoning, and next-subtask actions for hierarchical control.
paper_cards.task: Unify spatial grounding, navigation, embodied QA, memory, and long-horizon robot planning in a single model.
paper_cards.novelty: Shows that one embodied reasoning checkpoint can match specialist systems while retaining explicit episodic memory and tool-calling for robot planning.
paper_cards.evidence: The official project reports 68.7 average embodied-cognition score, 55.5 R2R-CE success, and a 38.3-point real-robot success improvement over actor-only control.

paper_cards.title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments
paper_cards.data: Joint pretraining over robot manipulation trajectories, egocentric human demonstrations, simulation, vision-language navigation, trajectory supervision, and auxiliary vision-language data.
paper_cards.method: A Qwen vision-language backbone with a DiT continuous-action decoder and embodiment-aware textual conditioning that unifies manipulation, navigation, and trajectory prediction.
paper_cards.task: Generate continuous actions and trajectories across tasks, environments, and heterogeneous robot embodiments.
paper_cards.novelty: Treats manipulation, navigation, and trajectory prediction as one transferable action-generation problem instead of separate specialist policies.
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports 97.9% LIBERO, 73.7% Simpler-WidowX, 86.1/87.2% RoboTwin Easy/Hard, 76.9% average real ALOHA OOD success, and 26.6% zero-shot DOMINO success.

paper_cards.title: Improving Robotic Generalist Policies via Flow Reversal Steering
paper_cards.data: LIBERO simulation and six real DROID manipulation tasks using pi0.5 flow-matching VLA policies, coarse human/VLM guidance, and small task-specific steering sets.
paper_cards.method: Reverse-integrates a flow policy from a coarse reference action into latent noise, then denoises toward a nearby in-distribution behavior; discovered noises support zero-shot steering, behavioral cloning, or RL bootstrapping.
paper_cards.task: Elicit useful modes from a frozen generalist flow policy for hard new robot tasks.
paper_cards.novelty: Uses the invertible correspondence of flow matching to translate coarse semantic actions into precise policy-native actions and a compact learnable noise-space controller.
paper_cards.evidence: The official project reports up to 95-point absolute gains, 80% versus 20% on six real DROID tasks, and auxiliary-policy training in under one minute.

paper_cards.title: World Action Verifier: Self-Improving World Models via Forward-Inverse Asymmetry
paper_cards.data: Nine tasks across MiniGrid, RoboMimic, and ManiSkill, combining action-labeled transitions with broader action-free video-derived subgoals.
paper_cards.method: Factorizes verification into state plausibility and action reachability, using a video-trained subgoal generator, sparse inverse dynamics, and forward-cycle consistency to target model failures.
paper_cards.task: Let a world model discover under-covered failures, collect useful transitions, and improve downstream imagination-based policy learning.
paper_cards.novelty: Turns forward-inverse asymmetry into a self-verification and exploration mechanism instead of estimating forward-model uncertainty directly.
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports 2x sample efficiency and more than 18% downstream policy improvement; official code and qualitative rollout comparisons are public.

paper_cards.title: Open-H-Embodiment: A Large-Scale Dataset for Enabling Foundation Models in Medical Robotics
paper_cards.data: Open synchronized medical-robot video and kinematics from 49+ institutions and multiple platforms across surgery, ultrasound, and endoscopy.
paper_cards.method: A cross-institution, multi-embodiment data standard plus GR00T-H VLA and Cosmos-H action-conditioned surgical world-model baselines.
paper_cards.task: Train and evaluate medical robot foundation models, action prediction, and multi-embodiment surgical simulation.
paper_cards.novelty: Provides the largest reported open synchronized medical-robot corpus and demonstrates both a VLA and one-checkpoint multi-platform world model on it.
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports GR00T-H as the only evaluated model completing the structured suturing task (25%) and 64% average success across a 29-step ex-vivo sequence.
